# Less work each frame in the night skies, fix/sky137 (1280x720, GUI scale 2 as the test world starts; render distance
# 12, no vanilla clouds, a clear midnight that stays night, the lyrics facing north and hidden with F1 (the sky stays),
# no constellations, shooting stars, sparkles or sky pulse, sky speed Slow, the game paused with F3 + Esc for each shot).
# The branch keeps the corners of the Moonlight, Synthwave, Eclipse and Comet skies from one frame to the next instead
# of working them out again, and repaints the drifting Moonlight clouds from kept parts. Nothing may look different.
#
# Compare each picture with the old code's, pixel for pixel, in everything that stands still:
# - sky137-moonlight-moon / -away: the blue gradient, the moon, its face and its glow, and the dark side of the sky.
# - sky137-synthwave-sun / -swirl: the purple gradient, the pink glow and halo round the sun, the striped sun (each
#   stripe and gap where it was), and the dark swirl with its faint rings overhead.
# - sky137-eclipse-sun / -band: the black sun with its cream rim, and the milky way above it and where it runs down to
#   the horizon.
# - sky137-comet: the comet's bright head and its broad warm dust tail.
# Look hardest at the horizon, where every shape fades out below it (the bottom of the Moonlight and Synthwave domes, the
# Moonlight clouds' foot, the Synthwave sun's halo, the milky way in sky137-eclipse-band): that fade is now worked out
# once and kept, so it must end exactly where it did, with no hard edge or band. Also the moon's and the black sun's
# rims and the sun's stripes: no hairline seam, gap or doubled piece.
#
# Some parts move with the sky's own clock, which runs on real time (also while the game is paused) and which the old
# code has no command to hold, so they can differ a little by when each shot fell: the Moonlight clouds drift (at Slow
# about a fifth of a degree a second), every painted star twinkles, the Eclipse's orange glow breathes (its brightness
# moves by up to about an eighth), and the Comet's thin blue gas tail streams. Compare those by eye: the same shapes and
# colours, no gaps, seams or missing pieces.
#
# Run it on the branch, and with -f mod_ref=2187b403 (land/batch103, the code before the branch) for the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky137 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/sky137.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/sky137 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=2187b403 -f script=.github/checks/sky137.txt
# and the same two with -f version=26.3 (where the comet's tails and head sit a hair apart, as the added light marks
# its depth there).

# A clear night that stays night, nothing but the sky under test
cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set direction NORTH
set skyStrength 0.7
set skySpeed SLOW
set shootingStars false
set twinkle false
set skyPulse false
set constellations false
set layout LINES
set placement SKY
option clouds off
option renderDistance 12
hud off

# 1. Moonlight: the moon left of where the lyrics face (yaw 148, 25 degrees up), the clouds low round the horizon
set sky MOONLIGHT
look 148 -18
sleep 10
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-moonlight-moon
close
look 328 -15
sleep 3
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-moonlight-away
close

# 2. Synthwave: the striped sun right of where the lyrics face and just above the horizon, the swirl high overhead
set sky SYNTHWAVE
look 206 -12
sleep 8
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-synthwave-sun
close
look 180 -55
sleep 3
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-synthwave-swirl
close

# 3. Eclipse: the black sun just right of where the lyrics face and low, the milky way above it; then where the milky
#    way runs down to the horizon on the left
set sky ECLIPSE
look 183 -18
sleep 8
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-eclipse-sun
close
look 100 -8
sleep 3
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-eclipse-band
close

# 4. Comet: the head right of where the lyrics face and low, the tails climbing beside it
set sky COMET
look 215 -30
sleep 8
pause nomenu
sleep 1
shot sky137-comet
close

# Back as the test world starts
hud on
option clouds fancy
option renderDistance 6
set skySpeed NORMAL
set constellations true
set sky AURORA
set layout WORLD
set direction FOLLOW
look 0 -28
sleep 2
